test_cases.title: A settings value is changed, kept after reloading and restored
acs: DERIVED: Values on External Site Management, Administration Charges, Postage Pricing Plan and Internal Test Consultant Department can be changed and are kept - app/ProficiencyTestingWeb/Admin/*.aspx.vb

steps.action: Open the settings page of the row (System Administration menu).
steps.expected: The page opens with its heading.

steps.action: Change the field of the row to the new value.
steps.expected: The field shows the new value.

steps.action: Save (page Save button, row Save link, or leave the box for Administration Charges).
steps.expected: The save completes without an error page.

steps.action: Open the page again and read the field.
steps.expected: The field shows the new value.

steps.action: Put the original value back.
steps.expected: The original value is stored.
